scripts.preinstall: node -e "const [maj,min]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(maj<22 || (maj===22 && min<12)) { console.error('\n❌ Node 22.12+ required. Current: '+process.versions.node+'\n'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.render:build: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend-svelte && npm install && npm run build
